hints.title: Declaring ElapsedTime
hints.content: Declare `ElapsedTime loopTimer = new ElapsedTime();` before the loop. Call `loopTimer.reset()` at the very top of each loop iteration to start the timer for that iteration.

hints.title: Reading elapsed time
hints.content: Use `loopTimer.milliseconds()` to get how many milliseconds have passed since the last reset. Log it with `telemetry.addData("Loop ms", loopTimer.milliseconds());`

hints.title: Negating stick values
hints.content: Remember to negate the Y axis: `leftMotor.setPower(-gamepad1.left_stick_y);`
